verdict.rationale: Supermemory documents a public API with official client SDKs (TypeScript, Python), concrete endpoints for add/search/memory operations, container tags, and code examples (client.add, client.search), plus a quickstart and API reference. This is clearly documented and usable to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate OpenAPI paths 404) and independent/hands-on developer corroboration beyond vendor docs.
